description: This file is a web UI source page for configuring local IP settings, including IPv4 and IPv6 address ranges, DHCP lease times, and related network parameters. It contains embedded PHP for server-side data retrieval, HTML for form layout, CSS for styling, and JavaScript for client-side validation and dynamic interactions.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves configuration string values from the device or system.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Returns a list of instance IDs for a given configuration path.
